name: @opencraw/ocr-tesseract
description: OCR for scanned PDFs, for OpenCraw: Tesseract (WebAssembly, bundled English model, other languages from @tesseract.js-data packages) behind the engine contract @opencraw/core reads a scan with. Each page is cleaned before it is read (background flattened, straightened, binarized), and every word comes back where it was on the original page.

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --packages=external --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.esm.js --sourcemap && tsc -p tsconfig.lib.json --emitDeclarationOnly --declaration --declarationDir dist/src --tsBuildInfoFile dist/src/tsconfig.lib.tsbuildinfo && node ../../declaration-specifiers.mjs dist/src
